events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI, not a person. I'm Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic. Halcyon's IT service desk has set me up to handle password resets and look up support tickets.

No one is typing these replies. I can't say exactly how Halcyon logs or reviews these chats, so the service desk is the place to ask about that.

If you'd rather talk to a person, call the service desk at **extension 4400**, 7am to 7pm.

If you're fine continuing with me, I just need your employee ID. The reset link will go to the phone number on file for you, not to this chat, so only you should be able to finish the reset.
